=== Two cursors pass every key to the editor
--- given
- a
- b‸
- c‸
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸
- c‸

=== A bullet-shaped line inside frontmatter is not a list
--- given
---
tags:
- a‸
---
--- nodes 2 hmd-frontmatter
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
---
tags:
- a‸
---

=== A bullet-shaped line inside a table is not a list
--- given
- a
- b‸
--- nodes 1 HyperMD-table-row_HyperMD-table-row-1
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸

=== A list inside a callout is left to the editor
--- given
- a
- b‸
--- nodes 1 HyperMD-quote_HyperMD-quote-1 HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸

=== A bullet-shaped line inside a math block is not a list
--- given
$$
- x‸
$$
--- nodes 0 formatting_formatting-math_formatting-math-begin_math-block
--- nodes 1 math
--- nodes 2 formatting_formatting-math_formatting-math-end_math-
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
$$
- x‸
$$

=== A list line with inline math is a list line
--- given
- a
- $E=mc^2$‸
--- nodes 0 HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1 formatting_formatting-list_formatting-list-ul_list-1
--- nodes 1 HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1 formatting_formatting-math_formatting-math-begin math formatting_formatting-math_formatting-math-end_math-
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - $E=mc^2$‸

=== A bullet-shaped line inside a fence under a list item is not a list
--- given
- a
  ```
  - x‸
  ```
--- nodes 0 HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1 formatting_formatting-list_formatting-list-ul_list-1
--- nodes 1 HyperMD-codeblock_HyperMD-codeblock-begin_HyperMD-codeblock-begin-bg_HyperMD-codeblock-bg_HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1_HyperMD-list-line-nobullet formatting_formatting-code-block_hmd-codeblock
--- nodes 2 HyperMD-codeblock_HyperMD-codeblock-bg_HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1_HyperMD-list-line-nobullet hmd-codeblock
--- nodes 3 HyperMD-codeblock_HyperMD-codeblock-bg_HyperMD-codeblock-end_HyperMD-codeblock-end-bg_HyperMD-list-line_HyperMD-list-line-1_HyperMD-list-line-nobullet formatting_formatting-code-block_hmd-codeblock
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
  ```
  - x‸
  ```

=== A bullet-shaped line inside an indented code block is not a list
--- given
text

    - item‸
--- nodes 2 hmd-indented-code
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
text

    - item‸

=== A bullet-shaped line inside an HTML block is not a list
--- given
<div>
- item‸
</div>
--- nodes 0 hmd-html-begin_tag
--- nodes 1 tag
--- nodes 2 hmd-html-end_tag
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
<div>
- item‸
</div>

=== A cursor on a paragraph passes every key to the editor
--- given
- a
para‸graph
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
para‸graph

=== A cursor on the blank line of a loose list passes to the editor
--- given
- a
‸
- b
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
‸
- b

=== Move up refuses a list that mixes tabs and spaces
--- given
- a
	- a1
- b
  - b1‸
--- when command move-up
--- then passthrough
- a
	- a1
- b
  - b1‸

=== Indented lines with no bullet above them are not a list
--- given
    code‸
- a
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
    code‸
- a

=== The list ends at a paragraph that follows it
--- given
- a
- b‸
paragraph
- c
--- when command move-down
--- then consumed
- a
- b‸
paragraph
- c

=== A list under a heading starts at its first bullet
--- given
# Title
- a
- b‸
--- when command move-up
--- then
# Title
- b‸
- a

=== Two cursors pass Backspace to the editor
--- given
-
- ‸b
- ‸c
--- when key Backspace
--- then passthrough
-
- ‸b
- ‸c

=== A bullet with no gap and no content is still an item
--- given
- a
-‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  -‸
